story.text: 이사한 지 일주일. 아직 짐 정리도 덜 끝난 집에 하늘이 불쑥 찾아왔다.
story.reading: i-sa-han ji il-ju-il. a-jik jim jeong-ri-do deol kkeut-nan jib-e ha-neul-i bul-ssuk chaj-a-wat-da.
story.en: A week since I'd moved. Haneul showed up unannounced at my apartment, which was still half-unpacked.

story.text: '집들이 안 해?' 그가 신발을 벗으며 물었다. 손에는 휴지와 세제가 들려 있었다.
story.reading: 'jip-deul-i an hae?' geu-ga sin-bal-eul beos-eu-myeo mul-eot-da. son-e-neun hyu-ji-wa se-je-ga deul-lyeo iss-eot-da.
story.en: "Not having a housewarming?" he asked, taking off his shoes. In his hands were tissues and detergent.

story.text: '이게 뭐야.' 내가 묻자, 그는 무심하게 던지듯 내밀었다. '이사 선물. 원래 이런 거 사는 거래.'
story.reading: 'i-ge mwo-ya.' nae-ga mud-ja, geu-neun mu-sim-ha-ge deon-ji-deut nae-mil-eot-da. 'i-sa seon-mul. won-lae i-reon geo sa-neun geo-rae.'
story.en: "What's this?" I asked. He held it out offhandedly. "Housewarming gift. Apparently this is what you're supposed to buy."

story.text: 짐을 옮기다 마주친 옆집 아주머니께 하늘이 먼저 인사를 건넸다. '안녕하세요, 옆집에 이사 왔습니다.'
story.reading: jim-eul om-gi-da ma-ju-chin yeop-jib a-ju-meo-ni-kke ha-neul-i meon-jeo in-sa-reul geon-ne-ss-da. 'an-nyeong-ha-se-yo, yeop-jib-e i-sa wat-seum-ni-da.'
story.en: When we ran into the neighbor lady while carrying boxes, Haneul greeted her first. "Hello, we just moved in next door."

story.text: 아주머니는 반갑게 웃으며 떡 한 접시를 건넸다. '이웃끼리 잘 지내요.' 하늘이 두 손으로 공손히 받았다.
story.reading: a-ju-meo-ni-neun ban-gap-ge us-eu-myeo tteok han jeop-si-reul geon-ne-ss-da. 'i-us-kki-ri jal ji-nae-yo.' ha-neul-i du son-eu-ro gong-son-hi bad-at-da.
story.en: The neighbor smiled warmly and handed over a plate of rice cakes. "Let's get along as neighbors." Haneul received it with both hands, politely.

story.text: 저녁엔 좁은 거실에 앉아 라면을 끓여 먹었다. 대단할 것 없는 집들이였지만, 그거면 충분했다.
story.reading: jeo-nyeog-en jop-eun geo-sil-e anj-a ra-myeon-eul kkeul-yeo meog-eot-da. dae-dan-hal geot eop-neun jip-deul-i-yeot-ji-man, geu-geo-myeon chung-bun-haet-da.
story.en: That evening, we sat in the cramped living room and cooked ramen. It wasn't much of a housewarming, but it was enough.

story.text: '앞으로 여기가 니 집이네.' 하늘이 방을 둘러보며 말했다. 무뚝뚝한 말투였지만, 어쩐지 든든하게 들렸다.
story.reading: 'ap-eu-ro yeo-gi-ga ni jib-i-ne.' ha-neul-i bang-eul dul-leo-bo-myeo mal-haet-da. mu-ttuk-ttuk-han mal-tu-yeot-ji-man, eo-jjeon-ji deun-deun-ha-ge deul-lyeot-da.
story.en: "So this is your place from now on." Haneul said, looking around the room. His tone was blunt as ever, but somehow it sounded reassuring.

words.example_en: I'm having a housewarming this weekend.

sentences.en: I'll invite you to my housewarming.
